title: Pec Deck
summary: A machine fly for the chest that's easy to control and push close to failure.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: pec deck / rear-delt fly machine.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.2 for front delts: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly front delts total.

setup.text: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height when you hold them.
Sit tall with your shoulder blades back.
Bring the handles together in front of you.
Let them open slowly until you feel a stretch in your chest.

form_cues.cue: Keep your back against the pad
Squeeze the handles together in front
Open slowly to a full stretch
Don't let your shoulders shrug forward as the handles meet.

mistakes.text: Shrugging the shoulders up as you bring the handles in.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Lower-chest bias, Less peak-contraction focus.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less peak-contraction focus, Steadier cable tension.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less peak-contraction focus, Less isolation.
